summary.text: Kevin Hardee, listed on Ballotpedia as Kevin J. Hardee, is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from District 105, in office since 2012, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Democrat David Wilson is also on the general election ballot for the seat.

paragraphs.text: Hardee is assigned to the House Rules Committee and the Ways and Means Committee for 2025-2026.
In 2023-2024 his assignments were the Labor, Commerce and Industry Committee and the House Rules Committee.
